clips.title: The story
paras: Free the Hollows is a quest in Shadowgale Forest, where ghost-like spirits known as wind hollows linger among ancient ruins. Trapped by an ancient tragedy, their sorrowful singing haunts the surrounding woods until someone grants them release.

Elves dwelling across the island have long regarded Shadowgale Forest as a haunted grove, and their superstitions are grounded in truth. Deep within the woods to the northeast lie old stone ruins where phantom apparitions known as wind hollows drift endlessly among the overgrowth. Rather than hostile malice, these spirits project an air of deep sorrow, trapped by the weight of whatever disaster befell the ruins in ages past.

On quiet nights, travelers near the ruins report hearing a strange, ethereal singing drifting on the breeze. It does not resemble any known mortal song, carrying an intense melancholy that unsettles any who hear it. Believing that leaving these shades trapped in their eternal lament is a torment, compassionate travelers seek out the wind hollows to destroy their spectral bindings and grant them peace.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but it's definitely a song and it's... Just so sad.
I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?
